topic: Wire quarantine assign to SP-071's RetagSource
detail: 'orch quarantine assign' calls a Retagger interface (source_uri, space, confirm, expect_from=quarantine). Until SP-071 merges, the build's Retagger refuses and moves nothing, and SP-028.1.a1's assign part is tested against a fake retag that records the override. After SP-071 merges: implement the Retagger with the RetagSource RPC and add a test through orchd showing the source leaves quarantine and the override is recorded.
note: Resolved in https://github.com/willesq/orchestrator/pull/192 after SP-071 merged: assign uses RetagSource (expect_from quarantine, --confirm), tested end to end through orchd by TestQuarantineAssignThroughOrchd.
